rectify_image_with_roll: rectify a torch image tensor using a camera model and roll angle with bilinear grid sampling
rectify_image_with_roll_and_pitch: rectify a torch image tensor using a camera model with both roll and pitch Euler angles
resize_image_to_fixed_size: resize a torch image tensor to a fixed width and height using bilinear interpolation with antialiasing
resize_image_with_camera_scale: resize a torch image tensor and scale the associated camera intrinsics proportionally to the new dimensions
pad_image_with_crop_and_center: pad or crop a torch image tensor to a target size with optional center cropping and camera adjustment
